message.content:
Owners in Europe commonly consider **Marriott**, **Accor**, **Hilton**, **IHG**, **Hyatt**, and selected independent/lifestyle operators such as **Ace Hotel** and **The Standard** when they want a **design-forward** or **distinctive-character** lifestyle positioning.[1][2][5][9][11][12]

The brands most often associated with that positioning include:

- **Marriott**: **Moxy**, **Aloft**, **Autograph Collection**, **W Hotels**, **Edition**, and **Luxury Collection** are all used in lifestyle or distinctive contexts; Marriott explicitly groups brands into “Distinctive” experiences with a unique perspective.[1][11][20]
- **Accor / Ennismore**: **The Hoxton**, **Mondrian**, **SLS**, **Delano**, **Mama Shelter**, **25hours Hotels**, **JO&JOE**, **Hyde**, **Morgans Originals**, and **TRIBE** are repeatedly cited as lifestyle brands with strong design and local identity.[2][4][9][16]
- **Hilton**: **Canopy by Hilton**, **Curio Collection by Hilton**, **Tapestry Collection by Hilton**, and **Tempo** are all positioned around neighborhood feel, curated design, or lifestyle-led stays.[12][20]
- **IHG**: **Hotel Indigo**, **Kimpton**, **Vignette Collection**, **Six Senses**, and **Regent** are in IHG’s luxury-and-lifestyle set in Europe.[5]
- **Hyatt**: **Hyatt Centric**, **Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **Andaz**, and **me and all hotels** are commonly used for urban, design-led, or locally rooted lifestyle positioning.[3][13][18]
- **Other names frequently mentioned by owners/investors**: **Ace Hotel**, **The Standard**, **Thompson Hotels**, **Meliá ME**, **Zleep**, **Jaz in the City**, **Firmdale**, **Malmaison**, and **Hotel du Vin**.[1][6][8][9]

If you want, I can also turn this into a **shortlist by segment**—for example, *upper-upscale*, *midscale lifestyle*, or *luxury lifestyle* in Europe.
